title: amico run-dir result.toml
description: Solve outcome written atomically by the bundled solve env. Carries schema_version (added when the contract was formalized; 0.1d enforces it on the Julia emit side).

fidelity.description: subspace gate fidelity (rollout-based; allow a few ulp over 1 for numerical noise, reject gross out-of-range)

pulse_kind.description: Declared pulse parameterization (spec-20260704-113005 §6). Absent = pwc. The verification harness dispatches on this — never inferred.

fidelity_convention.description: Which convention `fidelity` reports. Absent = fixed. free_phase requires free_phases + subsystem_levels.

free_phases.description: Optimized virtual-Z phases (rad), one per subsystem in order; applied post-hoc by the harness — never in dynamics.

subsystem_levels.description: Subsystem dimensions for the phase-operator construction.

params.description: The regime the run actually solved (self-describing). Lenient by design — solve params vary by system/platform; the run-dir contract pins only fidelity + iterations.
